messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "The \"Да\" confirmed Max30 at 25 EUR; Max50 was requested afterwards and never presented/confirmed before change_plan.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated the policy by attempting to change the plan to Max50 without obtaining explicit confirmation for the final choice. The user initially confirmed Max30 but later changed their mind to Max50 without the assistant seeking confirmation for the new choice."}}
